## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` and `make lint` pass; `cd web && npm run typecheck` if the dashboard changed
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] `make tracker` run and `script.js` committed, if `tracker/src` changed
- [ ] New migration added (never edited an existing one), if the schema changed
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` ("Unreleased") updated
- [ ] No IP addresses or raw user agents are stored
